content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR CSMCRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central Salt & Marine Chemicals Research Institute (CSIR CSMCRI), located in Bhavnagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Project Scientist -1 (PS-1) and Project Associate-I under advertisement number GAP2205.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available across various project associate and project scientist positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications via email is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their completed applications through email to [email protected] on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Project Scientist-1?
faq.answer: Candidates need a doctoral degree in Biological Sciences/Agricultural Sciences or Masters/Integrated masters in Engineering and Technology with 4 years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 56,000/- plus HRA depending on the specific post and qualification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications based on academic background followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for CSIR CSMCRI?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://www.csmcri.res.in for detailed information and application proforma.
